dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Is that a trick question? I'm on my way to have a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Ooh, er... Oh it's fine, I don't think my wife will have overheard that.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: So I actually had to sneak out to buy some wine... *sigh* How can you deny a Mondstadter the right to drink...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: When even one of the Four Drunkards is a woman, how can my wife be so narrow-minded.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: You wanna know more about them, eh? Hehehe... Why, they are nothing short of legends in Mondstadt, on par with the Knights of Favonius' Grand Master Varka...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: ...I can see you're only pretending to follow. Are you from out of town? No wonder you haven't heard.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: There's no point giving you their real names then, but I'll give you their nicknames and see if you can figure it out...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: They are Sir Dullwits the Oblivious Merchant, Dame Workshy the Absentee Boss, Oddears the Incredible Hunter, and Rookie McSchoolboy the Inexperienced Adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Should be pretty obvious by now, huh? Hehehe, talk to you later!
